name: boardId
label: Board

nested.name: phaseId
nested.label: Phase
nested.help: Phase to place the card in. Leave empty to keep the first phase. Perpetuus always creates cards in the first phase, so a different phase means a second request that moves the card.

nested.name: tagIds
nested.label: Tags
nested.help: Tags of the selected board. When mapping, tag IDs or tag slugs are accepted.

nested.name: assigneeIds
nested.label: Assignees
nested.help: Board members responsible for it. Choose the board first.

help: The board of the card. After you choose it, its custom fields appear below; fields required by the form phase are marked as required.

name: title
label: Title
help: Card title (the `name` field of the board).

name: contactId
label: Contact ID
help: Contact linked to the card. Map a contact ID, for example from Create or update a contact.

name: dueDate
label: Due date
help: Date and time of the deadline.

name: fields
label: Other custom fields
help: Custom fields as slug and value pairs. Use it when the board is mapped from a previous module, so the fields above cannot load. Values here override the fields above.
